name: babysteps-cloud
description: Read and record BabySteps Cloud care logs and journal memories with household permissions.

interface.longDescription: BabySteps is for adult parents and authorized adult caregivers, exclusively. Use an invitation-only BabySteps Cloud account to organize care for children in your household: review saved bottle feeds, sleep and diapers, record care entries, draft Journal events and memories, and review corrections. The public connection excludes structured growth measurements, latching records and diaper colour fields. Journals remain free text and may contain personal or sensitive information supplied by caregivers. Children are not intended users and may not create accounts. Caregiver-managed records can contain information about children in their care; permitted records are shared with ChatGPT when requested through the connection. Access follows household permissions and the scopes you grant. An invitation is required before connecting; installing this plugin does not grant account access. BabySteps does not diagnose, prescribe or provide emergency monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Log 90 ml of formula, finished now.

review.commerce_description: BabySteps is currently free. This plugin does not offer purchases or checkout.
prompts: Log 90 ml of formula, finished now.
Show a draft changing that bottle to 100 ml.
Draft a journal entry for today: we read a picture book together after lunch. Let me review it before saving.

publication.release_notes: Public MCP data-scope reduction: removed growth reading, creation, correction and deletion; excluded latching inputs and records; removed diaper colour from tool schemas and returned records, previews and receipts. The same limits apply to existing grants, old proposals and browser proposal review. Bottle and sleep logging, basic diaper logging, free-text event/memory journals, child naming, consent selection, weather and other tools remain available as permitted. Journals have no new content filter or automatic redaction, and may contain caregiver-supplied sensitive information, including care details excluded from structured fields. These restrictions apply to cloud MCP, while the ordinary app and self-hosted MCP retain their full care features. The prior explicit tool annotation fixes remain in place.
